lines.en: Crawls, growling low
Emerges slowly from the ground
Spits to hit the ground
Uses claws to dig forward
Rolls to dodge attacks
Slowly crawls out of the cocoon
Chases player, ground cracks
Spits corrosive saliva
Digs with claws
Smashes ground, dust flies
Rests in cocoon
Slowly moves, observing
Curls into a ball
Waits for prey
Closes eyes, breathes steadily

lines.zh: 静静地栖息于巢穴深处
lines.en: Rests quietly deep in the nest
Body wriggles slightly
Periodically opens eyes
Defends its territory

lines.zh: 茧里很静，虫巢都在听我。
lines.en: The cocoon is quiet, and the whole nest listens.

lines.zh: 十二块蜕壳，我一块块数过。
lines.en: I have counted my twelve shed shells, one by one.
The slime on the cocoon wall is still warm.

lines.zh: 我听着虫巢里细小的爬动声。
lines.en: I listen to the small crawling in the nest.

lines.zh: 螯肢在土里磨着，慢慢等。
lines.en: I grind my chelicerae in the soil and wait.
The eggs at the nest's floor run warm.

lines.zh: 我在茧里翻了个身，土落下。
lines.en: I turn in the cocoon and soil falls.

lines.zh: 我从茧里醒来，虫巢都在响。
lines.en: I wake from the cocoon, and the hive echoes.
Through the cocoon's seam, a row of my eyes opens.

lines.zh: 我的茧在巢底，你们找到这里了。
lines.en: My cocoon sits at the nest's depth, and you found it.
Starts tracking the player

lines.zh: 虫巢最深处，那枚茧是我。
lines.en: The cocoon in the deepest nest is me.
Glows with hostility
I count every step you shift.
Greedy glint in its eyes
Locks onto target, ready to attack
Sharp eyes, seeking an opportunity

lines.zh: 骨壳下的眼睛，认出了活物。
lines.en: Beneath the bone shell, my eyes find the living.

lines.zh: 你踩到蜕壳了，我听见了。
lines.en: You stepped on a shed shell; I heard it.

lines.zh: 这点温度，在虫巢里很扎眼。
lines.en: That warmth stands out in the nest.

lines.zh: 你身上没有虫巢的气味。
lines.en: You carry no nest scent.
I lift my head and the cocoon silk trembles.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中带着痛苦的哀鸣
lines.en: Sibilant wail of agony

lines.zh: 蠕动的身躯散发出痛苦的颤栗
lines.en: Quivering body writhes in pain
Shell cracks, pain spreading

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中夹杂着微弱的求救
lines.en: Sibilant cries for help

lines.zh: 痛苦扭曲了它嘶嘶的叫声
lines.en: Pain warps its sibilant voice

lines.zh: 痛苦的嘶嘶声中带着绝望
lines.en: Desperate sibilant cries of pain

lines.zh: 痛苦使它嘶嘶声变得低沉
lines.en: Sibilant voice becomes low with pain

lines.zh: 痛苦的嘶嘶声中夹杂着呻吟
lines.en: Sibilant cry with moans of pain

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中透露出深深的痛苦
lines.en: Deep sibilant pain

lines.zh: 痛苦使它的嘶嘶声变得模糊
lines.en: Sibilant voice becomes indistinct with pain
Craving your life force.
Your scent is alluring.
Approach me, and I'll bless you.

lines.zh: 你的血肉，滋养我的巢穴。
lines.en: Your flesh feeds my nest.
I can smell the heat on you.
You are my future.
Devour your soul.
You are my haven.
Your life force, I desire it.
The soil you stand on, I just loosened.
The ground trembles; I'm here.
Collide with your body.
You can't escape my strike.
My bone shell leaves you numb.
I'll粉碎 you.
This impact throws up the soil.

lines.zh: 你的头颅将与地面同在。
lines.en: Your head will join the ground.
Dodge, but you can't.
You'll be launched.

lines.zh: 茧一破，整座虫巢都醒了。
lines.en: The cocoon splits, and the hive wakes.
Mate with me, for stronger offspring.
Your body is fit for mating.
Let our genes combine.
Mating, for our clan's growth.
Mating, for life's continuation.

lines.zh: 我的后代需要你的力量。
lines.en: My offspring need your strength.

lines.zh: 虫巢深处，茧里等交配季。
lines.en: Deep in the nest, waiting in the cocoon.
Your blood will flow in the young.
Mating, for our future.
Mating, for mutual prosperity.

lines.zh: 壳中醒来，猎物何其鲜美！
lines.en: Awake in the cocoon, prey tastes so good!

lines.zh: 你敢靠近，便是我的食粮！
lines.en: You dare to approach, you become my food!
Break the soil and enjoy the feast!

lines.zh: 腐烂之肉，滋养我的力量！
lines.en: Decaying flesh, nourishes my power!
Golden apples, my desire!
This meat will feed the eggs below.
Egg, my future!

lines.zh: 地壳之下，是我们的盛宴！
lines.en: Beneath the earth, our feast!
Advanced experience, my wealth!
Corroded claws, my weapon!
Prey in sight, hunt begins!
In the nest's cocoon, I woke.
Deep underground, hunt you!
Ants, I will crush you!

lines.zh: 虫巢深处，茧里传来我的声音。
lines.en: My voice comes from the cocoon deep in the nest.
Earth trembles, you tremble!
Touch me, and you die!
You cannot stop my attack!
You are but my lunch!
Break through the earth, devour you!
You have entered the egg-laying depth.
Nothing living may walk loose in my nest.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，传到巢底了。
lines.en: Your steps reach the nest's bottom.

lines.zh: 我认出你脚下的那块土。
lines.en: I know the patch of soil under your feet.
Target locked, prepare to hunt!

lines.zh: 我在地底算好你的落点。
lines.en: Underground, I have worked out where you land.
My prey, getting closer!

lines.zh: 大地震动，猎物动弹不得！
lines.en: Earth trembles, prey cannot move!
I will crush you!

lines.zh: 你逃不了，我的爪子来了！
lines.en: You cannot escape, my claws come!
Break through the earth, let the earth witness!
Break the shell, consume souls!
I crawl against the soil; you can't hear me.
Decaying flesh, my feast!
First I loosen the ground, then take you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，我早挖空了。
lines.en: The ground you stand on I already hollowed.

lines.zh: 我的唾液能蚀穿你的靴。
lines.en: My spittle eats through your boots.

lines.zh: 你听到土响时，我已经在下面。
lines.en: When you hear the soil, I am already beneath.

lines.zh: 砸地那一下，你跳不起来。
lines.en: When I slam, you cannot jump.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，预备破土。
lines.en: I count your steps and prepare to break through.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡不住地下的冲撞。
lines.en: Your shield cannot stop an upward charge.

lines.zh: 这片巢土，只认我的气味。
lines.en: This nest soil answers only my scent.
I bite down, sand in my teeth.
Move, or you're dead!
I'm gonna pound the ground!
I'm headbutting you!

lines.zh: 我从地下钻出来，你躲不开！
lines.en: I'm burrowing up, you can't avoid it!
Feel the ground shake!
My chelicerae close and soil squeezes out.
None of you will live!

lines.zh: 我的茧在巢底，你敢进来吗？
lines.en: My cocoon is at the nest floor; dare you come in?

lines.zh: 你躲不了，我就在这里等你！
lines.en: You can't avoid me, I'll wait here!

lines.zh: 螯肢一夹，你的护腿凹了。
lines.en: My chelicerae clamp and your greave dents.
I spit once and the ground smokes white.

lines.zh: 从你背后破土，撞你的腰。
lines.en: I burst up behind you and hit your flank.
The last slam of my charge hits hardest.
From the depths of the hive...
Awakening from the cocoon, I fight!
Breaking through the soil!
My home in the hive depths.

lines.zh: 虫巢深处的茧，是我的王座。
lines.en: The cocoon deep in the nest is my throne.
The queen of the hive, I am!
I am the Primordial Bone Crawler Queen!

lines.zh: 巢土一翻，我从茧里抬头。
lines.en: The nest soil turns and I lift my head from the cocoon.
I have arrived, guardian of the hive!

lines.zh: 我是虫巢的女王，无可阻挡！
lines.en: I am the queen of the hive, unstopable!

lines.zh: 虫巢最深处，茧裂了一线。
lines.en: Deepest in the nest, a seam opens in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 我从十二层蜕壳下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under twelve layers of shed shell.
The soil moves first; then I rise.
The queen at the nest's floor wakes.
Bone shells grind; the nest echoes.

lines.zh: 我带着四瓶经验瓶的气味。
lines.en: I come with the scent of four bottles of experience.

lines.zh: 金苹果在我巢里发着光。
lines.en: Golden apples glow in my nest.

lines.zh: 锈爪埋在土里，等我来取。
lines.en: The rusty claw lies buried, waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我的卵在身下，微微搏动。
lines.en: My eggs pulse slightly beneath me.

lines.zh: 虫巢的门，从来只往里开。
lines.en: The nest's door has always opened inward.

lines.zh: 火焰烧灼，嘶嘶声中带着哀嚎
lines.en: Sibilant wail from flames

lines.zh: 摔落大地，嘶嘶声中带着痛苦
lines.en: Sibilant pain from fall

lines.zh: 陷入沼泽，嘶嘶声中带着喘息
lines.en: Sibilant breath from mire

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击，嘶嘶声中带着震颤
lines.en: Sibilant tremor from explosion

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿，嘶嘶声中带着哀号
lines.en: Sibilant cry from arrow

lines.zh: 魔力打击，嘶嘶声中带着扭曲
lines.en: Sibilant warping from magic

lines.zh: 饥饿难耐，嘶嘶声中带着虚弱
lines.en: Sibilant weakness from hunger

lines.zh: 雷击痛击，嘶嘶声中带着尖叫
lines.en: Sibilant scream from lightning

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，嘶嘶声中带着绝望
lines.en: Sibilant despair in void
